items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:52:1
items.html:
The Tree of Knowledge is in Yetzira — its good is Metatron, and its evil is Samael etc. After Yetzira descended and clothed in Assiya, Yetzira too is called the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil, by the name of Assiya. Meaning, after the sin the six upper ones of Yetzira fell to the place of the six lower ones of Assiya, and her lower half, that is, from the Chazeh [chest] downward, fell to the place of the shells. Therefore she is now found half good, that is, her KHB HGT down to the Chazeh, where she stands above the dwelling of the shells, and half evil, that is, her TNHYM from the Chazeh downward, which are clothed in the dwelling of the shells, where the lower ones cannot receive the illumination of Yetzira except as it passes through the shells. And this is what he says, “good, Metatron,” that is, the discernment of from the Chazeh upward in her, “and evil, Samael,” that is, the discernment of from the Chazeh downward in her, which is clothed in the dwelling of the shells, whose head is called Samael. This is the secret of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil: good from the side of Metatron, and evil from the side of Samael. And all this was done because of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, as above; but before the sin, the Tree of Knowledge was only in Assiya.
And one must understand this, for before the sin the world of Assiya, too, had no contact whatsoever with the dwelling of the shells, as above; if so, why was the world of Assiya in the discernment of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil? And more than that: according to what the ARI writes below, page 1938, item 87, on the eve of Shabbat in the afternoon, before the sin of Adam HaRishon, all of BYA then rose to Atzilut, and Yetzira and Assiya rose to the place of ZON of Atzilut and were face to face. See there. Thus the world of Assiya was already in the place of the Nukva of Atzilut with all her ten Sefirot; if so, how does he say here that she was in the discernment of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil? And one cannot say that the sin came before that, for after the sin the worlds had already fallen, as above. Moreover, we say in Tractate Sanhedrin, page 38b, that in the tenth hour he sinned, in the eleventh he was judged, and in the twelfth he was banished from the Garden of Eden. Thus the sin came after the afternoon. If so, how are there good and evil in Assiya, which had risen to Atzilut, when of Atzilut it is written, “evil shall not dwell with You”?
Indeed, when you examine Sha’ar HaPesukim [Gate of the Verses], Bereshit, Siman 2, the passage beginning “And from the tree,” you will find that the ARI himself dealt with this and resolved it there, and these are his words: By way of generality we shall explain to you one rule, by which all the aforementioned sayings will be resolved and settled. Know that every discernment of the middle line from the Chazeh downward, where the lights are revealed, whether in ZA, or in the Nukva of Atzilut, or in Beria, or in Yetzira, or in Assiya, is called the Tree of Knowledge, etc. End of quote. Thus what the ARI says here, that the Tree of Knowledge is only in Assiya, means in the Assiya of every Partzuf and of every degree of the degrees and the worlds; for from the Chazeh downward of every world and every Partzuf is regarded as the discernment of Assiya, or the Malchut of that Partzuf, although there are five Sefirot there, TNHYM, as is known. But not all of the Assiya of the Partzuf is called the Tree of Knowledge, only the discernment of the middle line in it, which is Yesod; for the three lines of Assiya are NHY, and the middle line is Yesod. And more precisely, the ARI explains in Etz Chaim, Gate 43, Chapter 3, that only the discernment of the Atara [crown] of Yesod is called the Tree of Knowledge. See there. For it is the end of the middle line of Assiya. And this is what the ARI says here, that the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil is only in Assiya.
However, the ARI says there, in Etz Chaim, Gate 43, Chapter 3, that the sin of Adam HaRishon was in the lower Garden of Eden, which is Bina of the Malchut of Assiya, the ground of which Garden of Eden touches and does not touch this earth of ours, that is, the point of this world. Study it there well. And it follows, according to the words of the ARI here, that since the whole world of Assiya was then already in the place of the Nukva of Atzilut, as above, the ground of the lower Garden of Eden, which is in the Malchut of the world of Assiya that rose, was also actually in the place of the ground of Atzilut itself. If so, how does the ARI say there that the ground of the lower Garden of Eden touched and did not touch our earth, at a time when our earth is below the discernment of the externality of the worlds, which did not rise at all in any of those ascents of the eve of Shabbat before the sin (as the ARI writes below, item 88, see there)? For only the internality of the three worlds BYA rose before the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, but not all the externality, which is the discernment of from the Chazeh downward of the TNHY of AK, which became the place of BYA, as above in item 3, see there. Thus the ground of the lower Garden of Eden stood at the ground of the world of Atzilut, while our earth is below the feet of AK, from the discernment of the Malchut of the first restriction, and the whole externality of BYA separates between them, so that the distance between them is very great. So how does he say that the ground of the Garden touched and did not touch our earth?
Indeed, there is great depth here, and it is a very important matter. First, one must know that even before the sin of Adam HaRishon the shells reached opposite the world of Atzilut, except that they did not have the discernment of face to face, but were only in the discernment of VAK [six ends] and a point, as the ARI writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 48, Chapter 3. See there. In their totality they are the three shells — a stormy wind, a great cloud, and a flashing fire — which are attached to Noga [brightness], and this Noga is half good and half evil. For when Noga is attached to the boundary of the Parsa of Atzilut, she is good, and when the three aforementioned shells cling to her, she turns evil like them. This is the secret of the serpent that turned into a rod, and the rod that turned into a serpent. For the three aforementioned shells are the secret of the serpent: when Noga is attached to the boundary of holiness, she is called a rod, and she is good; and when the shells cling to her, the rod turns into a serpent, and it is evil.
And the explanation of the matter is that the shells are built from the deficiencies in holiness, in the secret of the verse, “I shall be filled with her that is laid waste,” for Tyre was built only from the ruin of Jerusalem. Therefore the root of the shells was made immediately with the deficiency that was made at the time of the emergence of the first restriction, by the power of the restriction that was placed on phase four, that she would not receive the upper light within her; and this is regarded as the discernment of the Malchut of the shell, and as the discernment of a point alone, that is, merely a root. But after the second restriction, in the secret of the bottom Hey that rose to Nikvey Einayim — when the concluding Malchut, which was beneath the place of the Sium of the feet of AK, rose to the place of Bina of the Guf [body], which is the Chazeh of Tifferet — the bottom two thirds of Tifferet and NHYM, which are Bina, ZA and Malchut of the Guf, became the discernment of a vacant and empty space without light, (as above, page 1889, item 3. And then, opposite this, the three aforementioned shells were made, which correspond to the three vessels Bina, ZA and Malchut of the Guf that now remained in the discernment of a vacant space: the stormy wind opposite Assiya, which is Malchut; the great cloud opposite Yetzira, which is ZA; and the flashing fire opposite Beria, which is Bina. And since this place, the space in BYA, caused a diminution in Atzilut as well, in the secret of “the amputee goes out with his Kav [wooden leg],” for they were lacking their posterior vessels, therefore there is the discernment of the three aforementioned shells opposite the world of Atzilut as well. But before the sin of Adam HaRishon the shells had no structure at all, and they were also separated from holiness, as above.
And this separation of the shells was made by the power of two great corrections that were instituted in the world of Atzilut: the first, that the inner AVI, which are the GAR [first three] of Haya, were concealed; and the second, that phase four was concealed in Radla [the unknown head], upon which the Mochin of Yechida come out. Meaning: the breaking of the vessels of the ZAT of Nekudim happened because the illumination of AB that they received at the time of the Mochin of Haya brought the bottom Hey back down to the Peh [mouth], as in the first restriction; the power of the Parsa was then nullified, and the ZAT of Nekudim expanded into the restricted place of BYA. Therefore they broke, died and fell to the shells, as is known. Hence, in order to correct this — that is, so that they could receive the Mochin of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] through the illumination of AB, which lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim to the Peh, and yet would not expand below the Parsa into the restricted place of BYA — the two aforementioned corrections were made in the world of Atzilut. The first: that the bottom Hey was concealed in Radla; therefore, even when the illumination of AB lowers the bottom Hey to the Peh, there is no discernment of actual Malchut there, but the Yesod of Malchut. And the second: that the inner AVI, which are the discernment of the GAR of the illumination of AB, were concealed, and there remained only the discernment of the VAK of the illumination of AB, which does not expand at all from above downward, but illuminates only from below upward, that is, from the Parsa upward alone. Therefore it is found that the power of the Parsa is always kept, so that it is not nullified as at the time of the breaking of the vessels, and no illumination of Atzilut will expand any more into the restricted place of BYA. And therefore the shells were completely separated from holiness, for holiness no longer expands below the Parsa, and the shells can no longer rob the holiness as at the time of the breaking of the vessels.
And with this you will understand what the ARI writes below, in item 56, that in the first discernment, that is, at the time of the birth of the soul of Adam HaRishon, although ZA rose to the upper AVI and the Mochin of Haya shone, nevertheless this did not help all the ten Sefirot of the world of Yetzira to be able to rise, but only the GAR of Yetzira alone, while the VAK remained below the Parsa. And this is because there is no discernment of from above downward in the Mochin of Haya, for the inner AVI were concealed, as above; therefore it helps only to raise the GAR of Yetzira, which are the discernment of from below upward, and they could rise to Atzilut. But the VAK of Yetzira received no correction from these Mochin, for there is no discernment of from above downward in them that would expand to the VAK as well.
With this you will also understand what the ARI writes about the ascents in the second discernment, on the eve of Shabbat after midday, when ZA rose to AA and attained the Mochin of Yechida: nevertheless, this helped only the GAR of the world of Assiya, so that they could rise to Atzilut, but the ZAT of Assiya remained below the Parsa and received no correction, as written below in item 80. And this is because of the concealment of the bottom Hey in Radla; therefore, even in the Mochin of Yechida, which come out by the lowering of the bottom Hey to the Peh, there is no coupling there on phase four itself, but on the discernment of the Yesod of Malchut. Therefore the Nukva of ZA cannot rise there and be included in this coupling, for there is nothing of her discernment there at all; for Yesod and Atara are the discernment of the Nukva of ZA’s own Guf, which serves the discernment of the coupling of ZA and Leah, which is the discernment of from the Chazeh upward of ZA, and there is no expansion there from above downward to the discernment of Rachel. It follows that only the discernment of from the Chazeh upward of ZA rose to AA and received the light of Yechida, while his part from the Chazeh downward, which is the Nukva of ZA, Rachel, remained below in AVI and received nothing of the Mochin of Yechida. Therefore in Assiya, too, only her GAR, which could receive from the great Nukva, Leah, rose to Atzilut, but the ZAT of Assiya received nothing of these Mochin and could not rise to Atzilut.
Moreover, even in the third discernment, on the eve of Shabbat in the afternoon, when the six lower ones of Assiya also rose above the Parsa to Atzilut, this was not a complete ascent through a coupling on phase four, for that is utterly impossible, since she was concealed in Radla, as above. Rather, the ascent was in the secret of the additions of Shabbat, which is the discernment of a great dominion of holiness, in the secret of “all judgments pass from her.” Therefore this illumination availed only for the day of Shabbat, and not before Shabbat was sanctified.
And this is what the ARI says in Etz Chaim, Gate 47, Chapter 5: “Adam HaRishon could correct only the upper worlds, but the world of Assiya, which is entirely shells, he did not correct, and this world remained in the discernment of back to back, etc. The externals have a grip there, between those posteriors, between the attached ones, and they are the secret of other gods, meaning gods that are attached to the posteriors.” The explanation of the matter: it has been explained that although ZA rises to AA by the power of the illumination of AB, which lowers the bottom Hey to the Peh, even so the actual bottom Hey is not there, for she was concealed; rather, it is the Malchut of Ima included in the Yesod of Malchut, and this suffices him only for the Mochin of Ima of the light of Yechida. For there is NRNHY [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida] in the light of Yechida, and ZA then received only the Neshama of Yechida alone; therefore only ZA and Leah rise to AA, while Rachel remains below, as above. And it is known that the Mochin of Neshama suffice only to be GAR for the discernment of from the Chazeh upward, but from the Chazeh downward remains back to back with Rachel, in the secret of “and their posteriors inward, and their faces revealed outward.” This means that there is illumination there only for the anterior vessels, called HBD HGT, but the posterior vessels, which are NHY, are hidden there inside the HGT, for they need to be hidden from the externals who grip them. For the whole craving of the externals is to nullify the force of the Sium of the Parsa, as at the time of the breaking of the vessels, so that they will again receive illuminations of Atzilut, as at the time of the breaking of the vessels. Therefore their whole grip is on these NHY of Assiya, which need illumination from above downward, whose correction is only through the nullification of the Parsa, as above, for then the illumination of Atzilut would again expand to the place of the shells, as at the time of the breaking of the vessels.
It follows that as long as the NHY of Assiya are hidden in the secret of “their posteriors inward,” and are not awakened to receive their abundance, the shells are separated from holiness. For they cannot suck from the discernment of the anterior vessels of Assiya, since these receive only from below upward, and the boundary of the Parsa is well kept, so that it does not expand through there into the restricted place of BYA, where the shells receive it. However, when the posterior vessels awaken to nurse from the illumination of GAR, by this the power of the boundary in the Parsa is nullified, for they can receive only from the discernment of GAR that come from above downward, which nullify the Parsa, as in the case of the breaking of the vessels, as above. Therefore the shells are called “other gods,” which the ARI interpreted as being because they are attached to the posteriors. That is to say, if the posterior of Assiya, which is the aforementioned NHY, were to draw the abundance of GAR from above downward, the abundance would immediately reach the shells, since they are their very discernment, that is, the discernment of the heart of stone, as above.
And as for what the ARI says, that the world of Assiya is entirely shells (in item 144), it is because in truth they grip the posterior of Yetzira as well; for even the world of Yetzira, which is corrected with the Mochin of Haya, can receive them only in its GAR, that is, only from below upward, for the aforementioned reason that the inner AVI were concealed. If so, they have a grip also from the Chazeh downward of Yetzira. However, that is only the discernment of half of Yetzira, and not all of it. This is not so in the world of Assiya, in which all of phase four was concealed in Radla, and she is the principal part of the world of Assiya; therefore it is regarded as entirely shells, for anything that she draws from her part downward comes into the shells, which are the remainders of the kings from the discernment of the heart of stone. And understand.
And this was the sin of Adam HaRishon, for he drew the discernment of the GAR of Haya, which shine within the posterior of Assiya and Yetzira, that is, which cross the boundary of the Parsa, as in the event that occurred at the time of the breaking of the vessels. By this he, too, caused a discernment of the breaking of the vessels, for his organs dropped, and they all fell into the shells; and he also caused a descent of the worlds, and the four lower ones of Yetzira and all the ten Sefirot of Assiya were greatly flawed, for they were clothed in the dwelling of the shells, as written below in item 94. See there.
And this is what he says: “Adam HaRishon could correct only the upper worlds, but the world of Assiya, which is entirely shells, he did not correct, for this world remained in the discernment of back to back; and there, in those posteriors, since there are many shells there, waste exceeding the food, the externals have a grip there, between those posteriors, between the attached ones, and this is the secret of other gods.” That is, as above: the posterior vessels of the world of Assiya are corrected only through the revelation of the GAR of Haya and the revelation of the Malchut of phase four that was concealed in Radla, which draws the Mochin from above downward and nullifies the boundary of the Parsa of the second restriction. And since this revelation will not occur in the six thousand years before the end of correction, it follows that there is no correction or sorting for those posteriors of Assiya, and all the shells grip these posteriors of Assiya, since they are the discernment of the heart of stone, whose whole craving is for that abundance, for it is their share; and likewise, all their vitality and the force of their existence come from this deficiency, as above.
And although in the third discernment, on the eve of Shabbat in the afternoon, the six lower ones of Assiya also rose to Atzilut, and Yetzira and Assiya became face to face, as below (in item 87), this was only by the power of the addition of Shabbat, which is the dominion of the holiness of the day of Shabbat itself, in the secret of “all judgments pass from her,” but not at all by the power of raising MAN [Mayin Nukvin] and sortings, for there is no sorting for them throughout the six thousand years, as above. Therefore, even though the posteriors of Assiya were then revealed and became face to face, with respect to the weekday they are still regarded as the discernment of back to back, for the addition of Shabbat rules only on the day of Shabbat, that is, after Shabbat has been sanctified. And this is the secret of what our sages said, that had he waited with his coupling until the day of Shabbat, there would have been no grip at all for the externals; and his whole sin was because he hastened his coupling while it was still a weekday. And understand.
And this is what he says in Etz Chaim, Gate 43, Chapter 3: “that the ground of the Garden touches and does not touch our earth.” For by the power of the ascent that was made in the secret of the addition of Shabbat, when the ground of the Garden rose to the ground of Atzilut, it certainly had no contact at all with our earth. Yet before Shabbat was sanctified, it was still connected with the other gods that are attached to the posteriors there, for with respect to the weekdays there were no sortings there at all, as above. It follows that it touches our earth, which is the restricted phase four, which is forbidden to receive any illumination of Atzilut — in such a way that it touches from the side of the weekdays, and does not touch from the side of the addition of Shabbat. And through the sin of Adam HaRishon in eating of the Tree of Knowledge — which means that he drew Mochin in the coupling of Yetzira and Assiya face to face on a weekday, and these Mochin nullify the boundary of the Parsa and come into the shells — he gave power to the serpent, which comprises all three shells, to enter the lower Garden of Eden and to touch the Atara of Yesod, which is called the Tree of Knowledge. And this is why the tree cried out and said, “Wicked one, do not touch me,” as the ARI writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 43, Chapter 3. See there. For through this touch, all the upper Mochin that Adam had attained in these three discernments of the eve of Shabbat, which are called Zihara Ila’a, departed, and he fell and was clothed in a body of this world of the shells. And see in Beit Sha’ar HaKavanot, item Qof-Kaf-Zayin-Tet, in Or Pashut, the passage beginning “And this is what the ARI says,” for there this is explained by way of a hint. Thus the matter of the Tree of Knowledge, that it is only in Assiya, and the matter that it is entirely shells, have been well explained. You will also understand from this that the matter of the Tree of Knowledge and the matter of the breaking of the vessels are actually one matter, except that this was in the worlds and that was in the souls.
